title: Singleton Fourier coefficients of majority
statement: For every natural number $n$, the majority function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube has equal first-level Fourier coefficients: for all coordinates $i,j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, its Fourier coefficient at $\{i\}$ equals its Fourier coefficient at $\{j\}$.
